title: [ingest] feat(loop): metric-driven self-improvement loop (target-repo → measure → metric-judge → optimize)
summary: Extends the self-learning loop from pass/fail+rationale judging into a metric-driven optimization loop that runs on an arbitrary target repo (its own source or a client project). Built as six increments: ① target-repo decoupling — resolveRepo(key) (explicit > task repos[key] > workspace); set_task_repo / POST /git/repo. git ops/worktrees can target any repo distinct from the daemon workspace. ② inline metric-spec...
